description: Defines the UsecaseValidator interface for audio use case validation in Android, including methods for stream registration, unregistration, starting/stopping clients, and verifying audio attributes.

classes.name: UsecaseValidator
classes.description: Interface for validating and managing audio use cases, including stream registration, client start/stop, and attribute verification.

methods.name: registerStream
methods.description: Registers a new audio stream with specified configuration and flags.

methods.name: startClient
methods.description: Indicates playback start or resume for a stream, returning audio attributes.

methods.name: stopClient
methods.description: Indicates playback stop or pause for a stream.

methods.name: verifyAudioAttributes
methods.description: Verifies and updates audio attributes for a connected track.

classes.name: AttributesChangedCallback
classes.description: Callback interface for changes in audio attributes for a port.

methods.name: createUsecaseValidator
methods.description: Factory function to create a default implementation of UsecaseValidator.
